class.name: SubProcess
class.description: This class grants access to run and manage sub processes with more fine grained control compared to OS.execute().

method.name: get_exitcode
method.description: Returns the exit code of the process.

method.name: get_process_id
method.description: Returns the exit code of the running process, or 0.

method.name: get_std_err
method.description: Returns what the running process put into its's std error stream since the last [method get_std_err] call. Only works if COMMUNICATION_FLAGS_STDERR is set in [member communication_flags].

method.name: get_std_out
method.description: Returns what the running process put into its's std out stream since the last [method get_std_out] call. Only works if COMMUNICATION_FLAGS_STDOUT is set in [member communication_flags].

method.name: is_process_running
method.description: Returns whether a subprocess is running.

method.name: poll
method.description: Reads from the running process's console output if applicable. Return ERR_FILE_EOF if a read cannot be performed anymore, ERR_UNAVAILABLE if settings does not allow reading, OK on success.

method.name: write_to_stdin
method.description: Pipe data to the running process.

method.name: send_signal
method.description: Send a signal to the running process. If the underlying operating system supports signals. (Windows doesn't.)

method.name: start
method.description: Start a subprocess according to the properties. Will return ERR_BUSY if something is already running.
